critical_code_review_comments: services/currency_util.py — clean 42-line module, deterministic mapping (country→iso), AED default + Dubai city fallback. Lower-cased return value is consistent with Stripe currency param convention. No issues.

services/scan_to_pay_service.py — currency now derived from merchant via currency_for_business(biz) at resolve, authorize (persisted on doc), and capture (returned on receipt). Stripe PaymentIntent.create() also uses currency_for_business(biz) (line 327) — AED now flows through to Stripe metadata too. No hardcoded 'usd' remains.

services/bill_split_service.py:174-194 — _merchant_summary() now projects {business_name, name, category_id, category, country, city, market} and coalesces `business_name or name` + `category_id or category`. currency derived via currency_for_business(biz) — flows to split.currency on create (line 283-284 fallback: body.get('currency') or currency_for_business(biz)). Fixes iter_209 bug. One remaining micro-concern: pay_share() at line 568 still falls back to 'usd' when sp.currency is somehow missing (sp.get('currency') or 'usd').lower() — benign because create_split always writes currency, but could default to 'aed' for strict parity. Not blocking.
mobile/src/utils/currency.ts — simple ISO-prefix formatter 'AED 20.00'. Default 'AED' is correct for Dubai home market. OK.

mobile/app/pay-checkout/[token].tsx:32 — ccy derivation `receipt?.currency || resolved?.currency || 'AED'` chains correctly; fmt() wraps money() so ALL amounts on both checkout and receipt use merchant currency. Verified rendering end-to-end.
mobile/app/my-splits.tsx:96 — merchant name picked from `sp.merchant?.business_name || description.replace(/^Split at /,'') || 'Merchant'`; now backend ships real name so first branch wins. OK.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE of currency bug (fixed in this iter): previously hardcoded 'usd'/'aed' strings scattered across scan_to_pay_service.py (authorize doc, Stripe intent, capture return) and bill_split_service.py (create_split, pay_share PaymentIntent). FIX: new services/currency_util.currency_for_business(biz) maps merchant country/city → ISO code (default 'aed'), called at every point of persistence/response. ROOT CAUSE of splits/mine merchant-null bug (fixed): _merchant_summary() in bill_split_service.py projected only `business_name`/`category_id`, but biz_demo_karak stores `name`/`category`. FIX: broadened projection to include both pairs + coalesced in output. REPRO (pre-fix): resolve a biz_demo_karak QR → currency='usd' (or missing); GET /splits/mine → merchant.business_name=null. VERIFIED FIXED: all 5 pytest cases GREEN against live preview backend; mobile UI shows AED everywhere + real merchant name on both checkout and splits list.
